take: You're in (98.7%) but the bye isn't safe yet (20.3%). Regular season wins still matter a lot.
You win it all in 24.3% of sims. Your biggest threat is Tyler's Talented Team at 29.4%.
Best trade they'd likely accept (37% yes): Christian McCaffrey for Dak Prescott + Trey McBride with Tyler's Talented Team. Title odds +8.4.
Backup plan: Luther Burden III + Emmett Johnson for Chris Olave (4th and Mom), +3.2.

Swing big if they bite: Luther Burden III + Christian McCaffrey for CeeDee Lamb + George Pickens (Andrew's Awesome Team) is worth +10.9, but it hurts their lineup so expect a no unless they're desperate.
Biggest risk: Trevor Lawrence getting hurt costs you 17.9% in title odds. Make sure you have a real backup there.
